item.title: Bergara B-14 HMR – Affordable Precision
item.description: For those who have an interest in entering the precision shooting world, one thing quickly jumps out. Price. It seems that accuracy comes at a price, and it can be a barrier for many. As a long-time lover of long-range art, I have shot countless rifles. I am here to tell you that there is a rifle out there that will serve you well. Also, it will still not break the bank. The rifle is the Bergara B-14 HMR. item.description: When it comes to handheld lights, versatility matters, especially when the job, the range bag, or the truck doesn’t care what battery you have on hand. item.title: MRDS PDW – From Zenith Firearms
item.description: Zenith Firearms used SHOT Show 2026 to introduce the new MRDS PDW variants in 9mm and 10mm. Roller delayed fans now have a compact platform that removes the buffer tube entirely. These are PDW-sized guns built around Zenith’s proprietary roller delayed blowback system. MRDS PDW - Compact Personal Defense Weapon These PDWs will be available in both 9 and 10mm. item.title: CZ 75 Legend: One of the Most Influential 9mm Pistols Ever Made
item.description: Few handguns have shaped the modern 9mm pistol landscape like the CZ 75. First introduced in the mid-1970s, the Czech-built pistol became a benchmark for ergonomics, capacity, and shootability. So influential that it’s been copied countless times across the globe. Now, CZ is revisiting that legacy with the CZ 75 Legend, a pistol built to celebrate the original design in its purest form. item.title: Sako TRG 62 A1 – Long Range Sniper Rifle
item.description: The world of sniper rifles is all about precision. Inside that realm, there is a goal to mix that precision with long-range capability. While hitting your target every time is critical, it is tactically beneficial if you can hit that target at extreme ranges. This reduces the threat to the shooter. While there are many rifles that have this capacity, few have reached the level of the Sako TRG 62 A1. item.title: CCW is an Art with a Touch of Science and a Serious Commitment
item.description: I started carrying a pistol concealed in 1983 and continue doing so to this day. For most of my adult life, it was all about being a cop, with the last 16 years as a lawfully armed concealed carry holder and trainer. Everything from a 4-inch full-sized revolver to some of the most compact pistols has been carried and properly concealed. item.title: Model 940-3 9mm Revolver – New from Smith & Wesson
item.description: While many have proclaimed their death, revolvers still remain a popular handgun. Their general small size and ease of use make them a solid EDC weapon. The challenge for many people, however, is that most defensive revolvers are chambered in .357 magnum or above. This can be tough on the wrists when training for long periods of time.
